# fw_pe_inspect MCP tool

> Inspect a Windows PE/COFF binary using craft-pe compiled into Fw's Fat-LTO ABI. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_pe_inspect MCP…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-pe-inspect/

Inspect a Windows PE/COFF binary using craft-pe compiled into Fw's Fat-LTO ABI.

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "fw_pe_inspect",
    "arguments": {
      "path": "<path>"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | yes | Binary path. |

## Input schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Binary path."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path"
  ]
}
```
